INTTEGRO_API_KEY.description: Create a dedicated API key in Inttegro Studio. This value remains server-side.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PRODUCT_ID.description: The active Kora Market Product ID resolved by the server at checkout.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PRICE_ID.description: An active Price ID belonging to the configured Kora Market Product.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_CUSTOMER_ID.description: Optional server-owned demo Customer ID used only by the companion mobile endpoint.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public origin for completion and cancellation URLs, without a trailing slash.
